info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Correspondent Bank Operations Status API
info.description: The Correspondent Bank Operations Status API provides real-time updates on the status of banking payments processed through correspondent banks. This API is essential for financial institutions and payment processors that need to monitor transaction statuses and ensure seamless operations. By querying the status of specific operations, users can quickly resolve issues, improve customer service, and maintain compliance. Developers integrating this API into their systems will facilitate smoother transaction tracking and enhance the overall banking experience.

get.summary: Fetch status of correspondent bank operations.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the current status of correspondent bank operations, providing insights on the processing state and any relevant details associated with the operations.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the parameters needed to retrieve the status of correspondent bank operations. The expected data format is JSON, which should adhere to the specified schema.

200.description: Successful retrieval of correspondent bank operation status.

GetCorrespondentBankOperationStatusReque.description: A string representation of the correspondent bank operations status used in GET requests.

nostroAccountId.description: The account ID used for nostro transactions.

recordStatus.description: The status of the record for the payment operation.

metadata.description: Metadata related to the payment operation.
